_comment: Editorial copy for the deck gallery. Art is composited into a three-card fan by cardz-win's scripts/build-deck-gallery.mjs — from the PNGs the app ships, or, for decks whose cards the app draws rather than loads, from cards the app renders itself (--export-decks). build.mjs refuses a slug with no art in assets/decks/manifest.json. 'credit' is optional and only present where art comes from outside the project.

decks.name: Felt House
decks.blurb: The house deck, and the one Cardz deals until you choose another. Printed courts, aces and jokers in the French pattern, serif pips on the number cards, and a brass filigree back.

decks.name: Valhalla
decks.blurb: A Norse woodcut deck with two-headed courts. The pair of Loki jokers are worth finding.

decks.name: Scarab
decks.blurb: Ancient Egypt on papyrus. A small gold cartouche beside each index shows the rank that card pairs with to make thirteen, which is most of Pyramid solved in the corner of your eye.

decks.name: Olympus
decks.blurb: Gods painted on marble, with a gold index laid over the plate.

decks.name: Herbarium
decks.blurb: A pressed-botanical plate book in ink and watercolour, with the four suits as four plant families — rose, marigold, clover, thistle — on a deep botanical-green table.

decks.name: Filigree
decks.blurb: Engraved in vermilion and iron-gall ink, the classic red and black, on an espresso-leather writing desk.

decks.name: Ornamental
decks.blurb: Fine Victorian ornament on a damask table. The first illustrated deck Cardz shipped.
decks.credit: Card art by Nicu Buculei, from his OpenClipart ornamental deck. Released into the public domain (CC0 1.0).

decks.name: Deepfield
decks.blurb: A space deck: dark navy cards, orbital pips, celestial courts, and four colours of suit instead of the usual two.

decks.name: Neon
decks.blurb: A midnight arcade. Near-black cards lit cyan and magenta, with glowing two-headed courts. The sign over the table hums and stutters while you play.

decks.name: Dread
decks.blurb: Gothic horror in soot black, dried-blood crimson and bone ash, with mirrored court portraits and reliquary aces. The table is altar stone lit by a candle that gutters under the cards.

decks.name: Fright Night
decks.blurb: An 80s Halloween deck on worn videotape: horror-video-cover art, the reds in hot magenta and the blacks in slime green, each ace on a haunted television, and two zombie jokers. Scanlines and a tracking bar run over the whole table. Switch table effects off and the tape pauses.

decks.name: Monosolid
decks.blurb: Paper-cut shapes in two inks on a dark table: tally pips, and courts cut down to a crown, an orb and a blade.

decks.name: Jet Set
decks.blurb: Mid-century air travel as a sunlit airline poster. The courts are the crew, each ace is a plane tracing its suit across the sky, the jokers fly standby, and the backs are route maps in navy and orange.

decks.name: Mono
decks.blurb: Signal orange and black on bone-white stock. Every card wears its rank huge, with tally bars on the number cards and aces flooded in their colour, on a pale stone table.

note: Cardz also has a High-contrast deck, which follows your Windows setting, and a Colourblind deck with blue hearts and diamonds against black spades and clubs.
